field_principles.auroc_in_ci95: BARE bool; true iff reproduced mean is within the frozen CI95. Downstream G2-local gate.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall-clock plausibility floor; seconds for verifier scoring.
field_principles.frozen_headline_unchanged: Confirms this reproduces rather than re-versioning the frozen 0.9131 headline.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal prefix; blocked_<resource> if a precondition failed.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Bare verifier-scoring substrate; scores cached triples on CPU, no live LLM; 1s floor.
field_principles.model_specs: Names the FoVer corpus and four scoring verifiers; explicitly not a live LLM.
field_principles.per_seed_aurocs: The five per-seed AUROCs; sample-size and reproducibility evidence, not a single point estimate.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Interpreter, dependencies, corpus, and verifier imports checked before scoring; anti-fabrication gate.
field_principles.random_seeds_used: The five seeds; determinism and reproducibility precondition.
field_principles.reproduced_auroc_ci95: The reproduced 95% CI across seeds; the spread that must overlap the frozen [0.9027, 0.9235].
field_principles.reproduced_auroc_mean: The locally-reproduced mean AUROC; confirms the frozen headline still computes in the current environment.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content hash catches silent corpus/protocol drift.

methodology_note: Verifier ensemble against cached FoVer candidates on CPU; no live LLM loaded or invoked. This confirms the frozen 0.9131 headline rather than moving it.
